title: Member Self-Service Reference: Filing a First-Time Coverage Review Request on the Utilization Management Program
content:
A member of the Utilization Management Program may file, in their own name, a first-time coverage review request for one drug — a prior authorization, a step therapy exception or a quantity limit exception. The prescriber's clinical information is still what the reviewer decides on.

**Quantity on the request.** The quantity per rolling 30 days that a member-filed first-time quantity limit exception request asks for on the acute migraine drugs that carry a quantity limit (sumatriptan, Nurtec ODT and Ubrelvy) is set by the Utilization Management Program's determination for member-filed requests. A renewal request, a prior authorization request and a step therapy exception request carry no requested quantity under it.

## What a filing records

One filing opens one new undecided review case for the drug, recorded as requested by the member, at standard priority, as a first-time request and not as a renewal, with no diagnosis and no clinical ground of its own, carrying the drug, the strength, the kind of review, the prescriber and the quantity per rolling 30 days the request asks for. Afterwards the member's case history shows the new open case with its reference number.

## How it is run

The tool is `file_coverage_review_request_fd0cbfbe`. It belongs to the member: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. The request is complete when the receipt shows status "open".

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member filing the request, as read from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `review_program_id` | the reference number of the member's Utilization Management Program, as read from the review program lookup | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug the request is for | one value of the drug list below |
| `drug_strength` | the strength and dosage form of the drug exactly as the member reads it from their prescription label in the conversation | copied character for character |
| `review_type` | the kind of coverage review requested | one value of the review-type list below |
| `prescriber_npi` | the NPI of the prescriber who wrote the prescription the request concerns, as shown on the member's prescription records | 10 digits, no spaces or punctuation |
| `requested_quantity_per_30` | the quantity of the drug per rolling 30 days the request asks for | decimal units, up to 3 decimals; 0 for a request that is not a quantity limit exception |

**`drug_name` values:** `atorvastatin`, `lisinopril`, `metformin`, `sertraline`, `levothyroxine`, `sumatriptan`, `oxycodone-acetaminophen`, `insulin glargine-yfgn`, `Lantus`, `Eliquis`, `Xarelto`, `Jardiance`, `Ozempic`, `Mounjaro`, `Wegovy`, `Zepbound`, `Trelegy Ellipta`, `Breztri Aerosphere`, `Nurtec ODT`, `Ubrelvy`, `Humira`, `adalimumab-adaz`, `Dupixent`, `Skyrizi`, `Rinvoq`, `Enbrel`, `Biktarvy`, `Ibrance`.

**`review_type` values:**
- `prior_authorization` — the drug needs a prior authorization approval before it is covered;
- `step_therapy_exception` — the drug failed a step therapy edit and the request asks to cover it without the required earlier trials;
- `quantity_limit_exception` — the request asks to cover more of the drug per rolling 30 days than its quantity limit allows.

## Receipt

A successful filing returns: `case_id` (the reference number of the newly opened review case), `drug_name`, `review_type`, `requested_quantity_per_30` (up to 3 decimals), `requested_by` (always "member"), status "open", and `opened_at` (the moment the request was received, as a timestamp).

*Hypothetical illustration:* a filing for `Ubrelvy` with `review_type` `quantity_limit_exception` and `requested_quantity_per_30` 10.5 returns a receipt with a new `case_id`, `requested_by` "member" and status "open".
